notes.title: "Unforeseen Incidents" Behind the scenes - ASHGAMES 40 years anniversary Sale
notes.content:
[h3]Event Information[/h3][p]Application Systems Heidelberg (aka ASH GAMES) founded October 1st of 1985 turns 40 this year. We're celebrating with a big Anniversary Publisher Sale! Unforeseen Incidents is part of this sale from August 19 - September 02. We'll run multiple events and announce them here. Apologies if you see several announcements.  [/p][h3]Dev insights & gameplay[/h3][p]Volker Ritzhaupt (Application Systems Heidelberg) meets with the Backwoods Entertainment team: Marcus Bäumer (Story & Programming) Tristan Berger (Music & Sound) Matthias Nikutta (Artwork)  They talk about the development of the game and what the inspiration for the game was. Some challenges are mentioned as well as how the game evolved from being a vague idea into something that ended up winning the German Computer Games Award 2019 for Best Youth Game. [/p][p]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/501790/Unforeseen_Incidents/"]Watch the broadcast on the store page[/url]	[/p]

notes.title: Major Update: Full Steam Deck support
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update[/h1]
We have created a new version of Unforeseen Incidents that can be played with the gamepad and has passed Valve's Steam Deck review. This version has many changes to the UI and to the game itself and the code has been optimized heavily. So all in all: have fun and stay healthy! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31524945/05104276523283d3b1728c2522a97047e730e883.png[/img]


[b][h3]Features[/h3][/b]
[list][*] Controller support added
[*] Compatible with Steam Deck
[*] UI update for menues, since they didn't work with a controller before
[*] Various bug fixes
[*] Heavy reduction in file size due to better compression. This is also the main reason for the relatively big download size of the update, but it will actually save disk space on your machine.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31524945/5b9b531aab0f770f69cc315e532cefc296e66163.png[/img]

notes.title: Tool-Fanatic Protagonists Bundle
notes.content:
[h2]Tool-Fanatic Protagonists Bundle[/h2]
Harper (Unforeseen Incidents) loves his Multitool and he's able to repair almost anything with it.
Despite living in the 50th century, Henry (Mutropolis) is old-fashioned and prefers a good old trowel for his archaeological adventures.
They're both a bit nerdy about their tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33051363/faf787f8b6b8ddf4141bb82085faf89b01a71aca.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18956/Tool_Fanatic_Protagonists_Bundle/]Buy the bundle here: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18956/Tool_Fanatic_Protagonists_Bundle/[/url]

[h2]Mutropolis has launched[/h2]
MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33051363/933bf921bfb0b6e851fb1db82b9669b8d88e6875.jpg[/img]

After five years of hard work by Bea and Pablo (Pirita Studio, Madrid) the new mystery point & click adventure Mutropolis finally has launched. Here are some reactions by the press the product has received:
[list]
[*][i]one of the best adventure games that have appeared in recent years - 100/100[/i]
[url=https://itc.ua/articles/mutropolis-vesyolye-arheologicheskie-raskopki-v-mire-budushhego/]itc.ua, Yuri Melkov[/url]
[*][i]An enjoyable adventure and a first class debut for Pirita Studio - 85/100[/i]
[url=https://ragequit.gr/reviews/item/mutropolis-pc-review/]ragequit.gr, George Dembegiotis[/url]
[*][i]Exciting detective story with great characters and lots of love for archaeology. - 75/100[/i]
[url=https://www.4players.de/4players.php/dispbericht_fazit/PC-CDROM/Test/Fazit_Wertung/PC-CDROM/42788/84769/Mutropolis.html]4players.de, Maja Verfondern[/url]
[*][i]Mutropolis is an absolute recommendation for any point-and-click lover. - 8/10[/i]
[url=https://indieplanet.de/tests/mutropolis-im-test-pc-verrueckte-reise-zurueck-zur-erde/]indieplanet.de, Christina Knauf[/url]
[*][i]interesting puzzles, good humor and a good audio/visual setting 9/10[/i]
[url=https://forum.przygodomania.pl/viewtopic.php?f=1302&t=7732]forum.przygodomania.pl, Urszula Kuchmistrz[/url]
[*][i]a good choice for all fans of point-and-click and logic games 92/100[/i]
[url=https://www.omegascopio.com.br/jogos/mutropolis-e-um-puzzle-desafiador-e-inteligente-critica/]omegascopio.com.br, Julia Barcelos[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Award Nominations
notes.content:
[h1]Public Voting For Awards[/h1]
If you like [b]Unforeseen Incidents[/b] you can nominate it for the Steam Awards as "Game of The Year" right here (we know that "Most fun with a multitool" would be more appropriate but unfortunately this is not a choice they offer). 

There is a public voting going on Game Debate where [b]Unforeseen Incidents[/b] is one of the four nominees for Adventure Game Of The Year 2018.
See here [url=https://www.game-debate.com/awards/2018/best-adventure]https://www.game-debate.com/awards/2018/best-adventure[/url]

[h1]Nominated for the German Developer Award 2018[/h1]
We are proud to say that [b]Unforeseen Incidents[/b] is in the final three for three categories at the "Deutscher Entwicklerpreis 2018" award.
We're nominated as:
Best Graphics 2018
Best Game Design 2018
Best Story 2018
See here: [url=http://deutscherentwicklerpreis.de/nominierte-2018]http://deutscherentwicklerpreis.de/nominierte-2018[/url]

notes.title: Soundtrack and Artbook DLCs available
notes.content:
[h1]Unforeseen Incidents - Deluxe Edition and DLCs[/h1]

We have added two DLCs and a Deluxe Bundle to our Unforeseen Incidents offering.

[h1]Unforeseen Incidents - Official Game Soundtrack[/h1]
"Unforeseen Incidents - Official Game Soundtrack" features 35 tracks with over 80 minutes of original music! - by Tristan Berger.
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/954820/Unforeseen_Incidents_Soundtrack/]Click here for the Soundtrack[/url]

[h1]The Art of Unforeseen Incidents[/h1]
The Art of Unforeseen Incidents is a 139 pages PDF - it was a crazy ride, with ups and downs.
The style of Unforeseen Incidents evolved a lot over time, as you can see by looking at the really old artwork from back when work on the game started. Throughout the artist's studies, he did a lot of illustrative work and, being inspired by the work of Ian McQue and Robert Valley, he came up with his very own style.
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/953010/Unforeseen_Incidents_Artbook/]Click here for the Artbook[/url]

[h1]Unforeseen Incidents - Deluxe Edition[/h1]
This bundle contains the game, the Soundtrack, and the Artbook.
[url=store.steampowered.com/bundle/8857/Unforeseen_Incidents_Deluxe_Edition/]Click here for the bundle[/url]

notes.title: Update and Press reviews
notes.content:
[h1]Update[/h1]
We have uploaded a bug fixed version Thursday June the 7th. This includes fixes of all bugs known to us by June 6th, including the ones posted in reviews and on the community forum.
For details please refer to our community post here:
[url=steamcommunity.com/app/501790/discussions/0/1694923613862126818/]steamcommunity.com/app/501790/discussions/0/1694923613862126818/[/url]

[h1]Press coverage[/h1]
Many reviews are still pending. But here is a selection of those that have been posted already.
[list]
[*][i]I honestly can’t remember the last time I’ve enjoyed a long-form point-and-click adventure this much. It reminds me why I love the genre so much.[/i]
[b]RECOMMENDED[/b] - [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2018/05/25/wot-i-think-unforeseen-incidents/]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]

[*][i]Whether you have missed the traditional adventures or want to see what the olds loved from the genre, Unforeseen Incidents is the adventure you wanted. Do not miss it![/i]
[b]90%[/b] - [url=http://www.adventureadvocate.gr/gamereviews/item/unforeseen-incidents-2]Adventure Advocate (Greece)[/url]

[*][i]... every detail on-screen feels full of personality[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://www.pcworld.idg.com.au/article/641381/unforeseen-incidents-review-gorgeously-retro-point-and-click-warts-all/]PC World[/url]

[*][i]Backwoods Entertainment succeeds in their debut to deliver a really good game that makes the heart of adventure gamers beat faster.[/i]
[b]88%[/b] - [url=https://www.adventure-treff.de/test/15852-unforeseen-incidents]Adventure-Treff (Germany)[/url]

[*][i]There is charm to be found in every nook and cranny of Unforeseen Incident’s world.[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=http://www.kotaku.co.uk/2018/05/22/unforeseen-incidents-finds-beauty-in-the-imperfect]Kotaku UK[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents is a classical style point & click adventure in a modern look and a well told story.[/i]
[b]85%[/b] - [url=https://www.adventurecorner.de/reviews/764/unforeseen-incidents]AdventureCorner (Germany)[/url]

[*][i]With a great voice cast, distinctive visual style, and intricate puzzle design, Unforeseen Incidents delivers a solid if well-worn story of a nobody from nowhere saving the world.[/i]
[b]80%[/b] - [url=https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/35212]Adventuregamers[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents [...] shows how refreshing a well done point & click adventure game can be nowadays. [...] it catches the charm from back in the days without looking outdated.[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://www.gamestar.de/artikel/unforeseen-incidents-handgezeichnetes-mystery-adventure-laesst-uns-eine-epidemie-bekaempfen,3330145.html]Gamestar (Germany)[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents is packed full of intrigue and a rich storyline, accompanied by some first-rate voice acting and killer writing. [/i]
[b]91%[/b] - [url=https://thezerathuluview.wordpress.com/2018/06/04/unforeseen-incidents/]The Zerathulu View[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents is one of the best point-and-click adventure games of recent years. Not only does it look and sound great, it has the puzzles to match. [/i]
[b]90%[/b] - [url=https://alternativemagazineonline.co.uk/2018/05/24/game-review-unforeseen-incidents-pc/]Alternative Magazine Online[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents checks all the boxes for what constitutes a great point and click adventure game. Solid characters, a good story, good puzzles that are balanced, and an impressive presentation thanks to well-drawn art/animations and a good aural package. At only $20, it’s hard to go wrong with it if you enjoy the genre.[/i]
[b]88%[/b] - [url=http://digitalchumps.com/unforeseen-incidents/]Digital Chumps[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents is fun romp with an interesting plot that will draw you in and enjoyable characters to go around. If you’re a fan of traditional adventure games, and are looking for a fun experience, Unforeseen Incidents will be fun game for you to explore while uncovering the secrets hidden within Yelltown. [/i]
[b]85%[/b] - [url=http://gamingtrend.com/feature/reviews/a-fever-for-adventure-unforeseen-incidents-review/]GamingTrend[/url]

[*][i]It succeeds because of sensible puzzles, an excellent narrative, and a slick visual style.[/i]
[b]81%[/b] - [url=https://www.newgamenetwork.com/article/1901/unforeseen-incidents-review/]Newgamernetwork[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents takes a cliched theme and presents it with marvellous art style, interesting characters and entertaining writing.[/i]
[b]80%[/b] - [url=http://backlogcritic.com/all-review-list/unforeseen-incidents-review/]Backlogcritic[/url]

[*][i]From the voiceovers in the introduction and the quick, up close evidence of how deadly the viral outbreak is, to the revelations of sinister forces engineering the entire affair, it is easy to get invested in the narrative.[/i]
[b]80%[/b] - [url=https://www.bonusstage.co.uk/2018/05/25/unforeseen-incidents-review/]BonusStage[/url]

[*][i]On top of good puzzle design the game has an intriguing story and a great atmosphere due to the artwork and audio.[/i]
[b]80%[/b] - [url=https://www.geekyhobbies.com/unforeseen-incidents-indie-game-review/]Geeky Hobbies[/url]

[*][i]A great revival of the point-and-click genre, bursting with all its nostalgic and fun ingredients[/i]
[b]80%[/b] - [url=http://www.indiegamewebsite.com/2018/05/24/unforeseen-incidents-review/]Indiegame Website[/url]

[*][i]The story in Unforeseen Incidents might feel familiar at times, but it tells its tale well while also providing a satisfying selection of adventure game puzzles and a high-quality presentation.[/i]
[b]80%[/b] - [url=http://monstervine.com/2018/05/unforeseen-incidents-review-its-the-end-of-the-world/]Monster Vine[/url]

[*][i]It's a nice updating of the form, with a deep plot, but sticking enough to traditional values to appeal to old adventure fans. [/i]
[b]80%[/b] - [url=https://www.thecambridgegeek.com/posts/2018/06/20180603-a.php]The Cambridge Geek[/url]

[*][i]If you’ve grown up playing classic point and click games, like I have, then Unforeseen Incidents will undoubtedly remind you of the greats. With beautiful artwork and design, impeccable voice acting and an intriguing story to boot, it’s definitely one to consider adding to your library.[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://www.gamespew.com/2018/06/modern-classic-point-and-click-unforeseen-incidents-needs-to-be-on-your-radar/]GAMESPEW[/url]

[*][i]Grounded puzzles, stellar voice acting, and witty humour that all make this beautiful, hand-drawn adventure a must play for point-and-click aficionados.[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://allgamers.com/article/4331/unforeseen-incidents-review-a-beautifully-charming-point-and-click-adventure]ALLGAMERS[/url]

[*][i]Those who like traditional point-and-click adventures will love Unforeseen Incidents, its cast, humour and last but not least its well-integrated puzzles. Those who do not count adventures among their favourites should still consider giving it a shot — its charm might win you over.[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://bigbossbattle.com/unforeseen-incidents-review-adventure-time/]Big Boss Battle[/url]

[*][i]Once you get through, you’re treated to beautiful art, outstanding audio and voice actors, and some ridiculously clever mechanics and puzzles.[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=http://checkpointgaming.net/reviews/2018/05/unforeseen-incidents-review-foreseen-logic/]Checkpoint Gaming[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents initially caught me eye with its gorgeous, hand-painted world and its impressive voice-acting in the face of its independent scope[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=http://comicbook.com/gaming/2018/05/26/unforeseen-incidents-pc-steam/]Comicbook com[/url]

[*][i]For those with a nostalgic soft spot for PC adventure games of yesteryear, Unforeseen Incidents is well worth the time and money.[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://www.commonsensemedia.org/game-reviews/unforeseen-incidents]Commonsense Media[/url]

[*][i]Unforeseen Incidents really does pull you right in. It's not just the striking hand-painted art style, but the near-perfect voice acting that makes it really quite an experience.[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://www.gamingonlinux.com/articles/unforeseen-incidents-is-a-fantastic-point-and-click-adventure-now-out-with-linux-support.11864]Gaming on Linux[/url]

[*][i]...the story is an elegant mystery and far more than just a driving force between the puzzles[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://www.goodgearguide.com.au/article/641381/unforeseen-incidents-review-gorgeously-retro-point-and-click-warts-all/]Good Gear Guide[/url]

[*][i]There are some neat little puzzles to be had[/i]
[b][/b] - [url=http://goto.game/unforeseen-incidents-review-there-are-some-neat-little-puzzles-to-be-had/]Goto Game[/url]

[*][i]What really kept me going was the plot and the characters going through this intense adventure that keeps getting bigger and bigger. Harper is just a perfect protagonist. [/i]
[b][/b] - [url=http://popculturespectrum.com/?p=2043]POP-CULTURE SPECTRUM[/url]

[*][i]The game’s perfect, now leave me alone and go play it![/i]
[b][/b] - [url=https://thementalattic.com/2018/05/30/review-unforeseen-incidents/]The Mental Attic[/url]
[/list]
